body:
Smoking with Molly
Ok, so I've been trying to find some answers and found nothing straightforward. So I became the guinea pig.
About 11pm, I got the molly, it is pretty clear crystals, so I had to try it, took out a small solid crystal and placed a 5 dollar bill over it on a card, it crunched like glass and still lost a tiny piece, but managed to keep 99% on the card, finished crushing out the big chunks with another card. I railed half the line in one nostril and the other in the oppisite since I like to keep things even for some reason?
It burned like hell. Like buuuuurned. The drip is awful, like spicy pepper salt chemical. But I felt it within minutes, it was good. Rolled up a blunt with the friends and smoked that along with a second one I rolled, headed back home (I do not condone driving under the influence of ANYTHING) but by that time I wasnt feeling it as much. Got home and split it up for my other friend who pitched in to try it. He took his and went to bed, I railed another line and got to wondering if I could smoke it. My research led nowhere, so I put the leftovers of the lines on the tip of my cigarette and lit it, didnt taste very good but I almost instantly felt a body buzz type feeling, it was different. So then I let myself sober up a bit, and finished up a bowl in my bubbler, left the ashes intact in the bowl and placed 3 small crystals on the ash, the way I've always heard of how to smoke stuff without a dope pipe. It immediately absorbed into the ash and burned almost like hash oil. I immediately felt the body buzz but it was more like a high. Lets just put it this way, I felt some type of good as to come write on here haha. It does not taste good but hey, I'd say it worked.
